actions.name: Send chat message
actions.description: Send a message to your Twitch chat.

schema.label: Message
schema.description: Up to 500 characters.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger.

actions.name: Give a shoutout
actions.description: Give another channel a shoutout. Twitch allows one every 2 minutes, so shoutouts wait their turn in your shoutout queue.

schema.label: Channel
schema.description: The channel to shout out.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger, like the raider.

schema.label: Skip if Twitch says wait
schema.description: Skip the shoutout instead of failing when Twitch makes you wait.
schema.hint: Queued shoutouts are never dropped, so this rarely matters.

fields.description: The Twitch user id of the channel being shouted out.
Whether the shoutout joined the shoutout queue. False only when it was sent right away because there is no queue.
The shoutout's place in the queue, starting at 1. 0 when it was sent right away.
Whether that channel was already waiting in the queue, so it kept its place instead of being added twice.
Whether the shoutout was skipped because of Twitch's rate limit. Only when it was sent right away instead of queued.

actions.name: Look up a user
actions.description: Find out who someone is, what they last played, and whether they're live. Use it in later steps.

schema.label: User
schema.description: The user to look up.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger, like the raider.

fields.description: The user's Twitch user id.
The username that was looked up, trimmed, without the @ and in lowercase. The login when a user id was given.
The user's login name, all lowercase.
The user's name as Twitch shows it.
The user's channel bio.
A link to the user's profile picture.
"partner", "affiliate", or empty for neither.
When the account was created.
The channel's title, kept from their last stream while offline.
The id of the channel's category.
The game or category they are streaming, or last streamed while offline. Empty when none is set.
The channel's tags.
The channel's language, as a two-letter code.
Whether the user is live right now.
The live stream's title. Empty while offline.
The live stream's category. Empty while offline.
How many people are watching the live stream. 0 while offline.
When the live stream started. Empty while offline.

actions.name: Make a clip
actions.description: Clip the last moments of your stream.

fields.description: The clip's id.
The link to view and edit the clip.

actions.name: Place stream marker
actions.description: Mark this moment in your stream so you can find it later.

schema.label: Description
schema.description: Optional note, up to 140 characters.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger. Markers only work while you're live.

fields.description: The marker's id.
When the marker was created.
The marker's description.
How far into the stream the marker sits, in seconds.

actions.name: Update stream info
actions.description: Change your title, category or tags. Anything left blank stays as it is.

schema.label: Title
schema.placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current title
schema.description: Up to 140 characters.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger, like what the chatter typed.

schema.label: Category
schema.description: A game or category name. The closest match is used.

schema.label: Tags
schema.description: Separate with commas. Replaces your current tags. Up to 10 tags, 25 letters or numbers each.

fields.description: The title that was set. Absent when unchanged.
The id of the category that was set. Absent when unchanged.
The name of the category the text resolved to. Absent when unchanged.
The tags that were set. Absent when unchanged.

actions.name: Time out a chatter
actions.description: Give a chatter a break from chat.

schema.label: Chatter
schema.description: The chatter to time out.
schema.hint: Can use details from the trigger, like the chatter.

schema.label: Duration
schema.description: From 1 second to 2 weeks.

schema.label: Reason
schema.description: Shown to the chatter and your moderators.

fields.description: The Twitch user id of the chatter who was timed out.
How long the timeout lasts, in seconds.
